item.title: Shooting 101: Myths and Facts About Snapping Revolvers and Slamming Slides
item.description: You’ve heard it before—don't drop the slide on an empty chamber, don’t snap the cylinder closed on a revolver. For some, this has been gospel since the first time they held a firearm. For others, it’s superstition, or maybe just old-school fuddlore passed down from someone who “used to be a cop.” But when you’re in the business of fixing broken guns, or making sure they don't break, you start to develop a sense of what’s actually going on.
